fact: The Mission's 2021 annual performance project says the national strategic plan Tunisie digitale 2016-2020 was being updated from late 2019 toward a 2025 vision alongside the 2021-2025 development plan, and that the sectoral strategic plan derives from it, with no separate sector policy instrument named.
title: Projet Annuel de la Performance pour l'année 2021 — Mission des technologies de la communication
publisher: Mission des Technologies de la Communication
